Contact us

We’re Here to Help

Whether you have a question about a product, need help with an order or require additional assistance using WeMall, our support options are designed to help you find the right next step.

Contact Us

Need help with WeMall?

Contact our team for assistance with using the platform, product enquiries, quotations, orders, delivery or general support. For product-specific advice, we can also help direct your enquiry to the relevant supplier or source of information.

Track Your Order

Stay informed about the progress of your purchase.

Use available order information to check the status of your order and, where available, delivery progress. If you need further assistance, our support team can help with your enquiry.

Returns & Post-Purchase Support

Need to return a product or have an issue after delivery?

Access return information and available post-purchase support to understand the next steps. Return and remedy options may vary depending on the product, supplier arrangements and applicable consumer rights.

Complaints & Feedback

Your experience matters to us.

If something has not gone as expected, you can raise a concern or complaint through WeMall. We aim to make the process clear and accessible and use feedback to improve the experience for customers, care teams and suppliers.

You can also provide feedback about your WeMall experience, even when you do not wish to make a formal complaint.

Accessibility Support

We want WeMall to be accessible to people with different communication, language and support needs.

If you need assistance accessing information, understanding the purchasing process or using WeMall, please let us know what support would help. Where available, we will work with you to identify an appropriate way to access the information or assistance you need.
